verdict.rationale: Sentry's Alerts system explicitly triggers automated actions (notifications, ticket creation, webhooks, integrations) when issues match pre-defined rules, and Autofix/Seer automates triage, root-causing, and even PR creation on incoming events. This is a well-documented, core rules-based automation capability, though it's not specifically 'AI-native' rule authoring (e.g., natural language rule definition) and lacks independent hands-on verification of the automation firing reliably. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of automation triggering correctly, and natural-language/AI-native rule definition rather than standard rule builder.
